features.name: ApplicationResources
features.note: Migrated app builds, launches, and constructs a complete, correct UIA tree (title, 13-item 'Scenarios' list, status/output region, all expected text), and Compare-Parity passes structurally 4/4. BUT the window renders VISUALLY BLANK: only the Win32 caption buttons paint; the client area is empty white. Verified by two independent capture methods — winapp screenshot (11KB solid color, x2) and PrintWindow PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT (5.7KB blank) — while the same tooling captured the UWP golden's full content at 145KB. Per the parity skill's 'Blank screenshot = fail' rule and because this instrument scores visual/behavioral fidelity, the structural pass is overridden to FAIL. The two HyperlinkButton actions (Trademarks/Privacy) do not respond in either app (they open external pages), so there is no behavioral regression to add.

notes.winui_build: dotnet build OK, 0 errors, 182 warnings (CA1416 platform-availability)
notes.checklist_caveat: Extract-UwpFeatureChecklist flattened the sample to 1 feature (no scenario list parsed from SampleConfiguration.cs); the live UWP shows a 13-item scenario ListBox. Scoring follows the single extracted feature.
